============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v24.22.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed (PeerUpdate)

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |   1208 ns | 827,724 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1628 ns | 614,123 | 341 | 1.35x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2812 ns | 355,679 | 341 | 2.33x slower |
| google-protobuf |   6055 ns | 165,150 | 341 | 5.01x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   4934 ns | 202,658 | 622 | 4.08x slower |
| JSON |   2385 ns | 419,367 | 791 | 1.97x slower |
